Do reported counts add up to their total?

Source: R/add-up-to.R
add_up_to.Rd

add_up_to() checks whether reported subgroup sizes, or other counts, sum to the reported total.

The function is vectorized over cases, but add_up_to_map() is more convenient for testing many cases.

Usage

add_up_to(summands, total)

Arguments

summands

Integer. The counts of one case, or a list with one such vector per case.

total

Integer. The reported total, one per case.

Value

Logical. TRUE if the counts add up to total, FALSE if not, and NA if a value is missing, negative, or not a whole number, or if their sum or the total reaches 2^53, beyond which a sum is no longer exact.

Examples

add_up_to(c(40, 37, 43), total = 120)
#> [1] TRUE
add_up_to(c(40, 37, 44), total = 120)
#> [1] FALSE

# Several cases:
add_up_to(list(c(40, 37, 43), c(10, 12)), total = c(120, 23))
#> [1]  TRUE FALSE
